question: Where do context compaction, full-result archives/recall, persisted memory/lessons/decision injection, retention budgets, semantic ranking/expansion and learning feedback actually flow from a run through CLI/SDK storage and back into the model?

Actual CLI consumer converts the provider into SDK memoryV2 options; inspect default/shadow/opt-in configuration, managed lease lifetime, attach-mode branch, and client reset.
Fresh SDK session loads project/home knowledge and skills, hydrates durable V1 task memory through injected filesystem, and reconciles evidence before use.

Hot observation-capture path samples error filtering, decisions/facts/discovery classification, provenance, safe artifact/evidence construction, explicit record_decision DTOs and claim dedup integration.
Terminal replay protocol and usage feedback: persisted finishing state, pendingTerminal validation, cancellation status, query terminal events, memory shown/reused counters and serialized append.
Real model-request consumer compiles correlated V2 memory, V1 task memory and active playbooks into protected per-step messages; stale-tool eviction archives full results before replacing bodies.

Runtime compaction hot path: governor/anti-thrash state, pre-compaction archive, programmatic and prompt-template semantic branches, post-prune rebuild, mechanical emergency trim and recovery telemetry.

Bounded archive and recall implementation: separate semantic/eviction retention caps, per-message clipping, pre-compaction and full-tool-result snapshots, pointer construction, keyword and toolCallId recall, provenance and empty-result behavior.
Model-visible recall tool consumer: direct toolCallId lookup, indexed verbatim search, optional consolidation search, additive receipts, empty/error fallback and archived-content staleness.
Durable archive round trip: optional repository binding, best-effort flush, bounded load, provider lease cleanup, archive hydration marker, dedup and independent per-kind merge budgets.
Sampled SQLite archive hot path only: validation, transactional replacement keyed by run, TTL/count pruning, bounded load and FTS/LIKE recall with failure envelopes.
Sampled SQLite retrieval hot path only: deterministic reference clock, evidence freshness, lexical ranking, explicit/derived usefulness tiers, pinned/workspace ordering and category eligibility.

Actual prompt compiler budgets and trust categories: authoritative metadata, verified vs reread/historical knowledge, warnings and ranking reasons, root/child caps, and concept advisory receipt counting.
Real SQLite close/reopen probes for fresh verified reuse, digest mismatch requiring reread, and forgotten claims retaining history; inspect assurance limits of store-level cold-start tests.

V2 deterministic evaluation consumer builds warm/cold contexts and simulates evidence/exploration costs, budgets and metric thresholds; distinguishes compiler retention assertions from live model reuse.
Current documented contracts for durable archive/recall, consolidation, provenance, compaction correlation/cancellation, typed task memory, child isolation and atomic transcript-memory commit.

SDK durable task-memory hydration/reconciliation, runtime relevance-budgeted compilation and terminal merge persistence; project/home knowledge and skills form an adjacent injection path.
Opt-in or shadow event-backed memory: observed decisions/discoveries/evidence -> canonical SQLite projections -> correlated turn query -> protected runtime prompt context -> usage/terminal events.
Archive snapshot/body caps and TTL, prompt budgets, lexical freshness/usefulness ranking, bounded semantic concept expansion, and actual retention/reuse evaluation coverage.
Active playbook loading and prompt/gate consumers, gate-outcome persistence, operator proposal/promotion/retirement, explicit decision supersession and prose lessons-to-skills workflow.

samplingLimits: Primary selections are 18 bounded sections totaling 4963 lines, including source, real SQLite cold-reopen tests, a deterministic evaluation scenario and current docs.

The 5908-line SQLite repository is intentionally sampled only around archive storage/search and retrieval ranking. Schema migrations, full append/projection replay, operator GC and filesystem-security helpers remain adjacent follow-ups.
The 3349-line serialized agents/context-pruner.ts and generated bundled-agent source were located by bounded searches; long generated matching lines were suppressed rather than read indiscriminately.

Semantic concept expansion, procedural playbook promotion/retirement, V1 low-level storage and consolidation internals are secondary follow-ups; their production consumer edges were discovered without classifying maturity.
No source edits, test execution, API/model calls, credentials or private configuration values were used.
